title: Disk Usage widget only shows information from partitions mounted on boot
line: The Disk Usage widget now shows a partition as soon as it is mounted, and drops it when it is unmounted, without restarting Plasma.
explanation: The Disk Usage preset lists its disks with the query "disk/.*/usedPercent". SensorFaceController expanded such queries into concrete sensor ids only once, when the widget loaded, and never again, so a partition mounted later (whose sensors ksystemstats adds at runtime) never got a row until Plasma restarted. The controller now listens to ksystemstats' sensorAdded/sensorRemoved D-Bus signals and, after a short debounce, re-resolves the sensor lists that contain a query; lists made only of explicitly picked sensors are left alone.

commits.message:
faces: Update query sensors when sensors are added or removed

Sensor ids like "disk/.*/usedPercent" were only resolved once, so a disk
mounted after the widget loaded never showed up until Plasma restarted.
Resolve such queries again whenever the daemon adds or removes sensors.

BUG: 424578
